title: Тама и друзья
originalTitle: 3 Choume no Tama Uchi no Tama Shirimasenka?
alt: Тама с третьей улицы: Вы не видели моего Таму / Tama and Friends TAMA of the 3rd District -Have You Seen My TAMA? 3丁目のタマ　うちのタマ知りませんか? 第2期
description: The characters are Tama, Momo, Wocket, Tiggle, Rockney, Pimmy, Bupkus, Bengpu, and Chopin. There is no consistent plot. Tama and his friends just have little, family friendly, adventures every episode. The only consistency is when a new friend is made one episode and flash backs. (Source: Anime News Network)

en: TAMA of the 3rd District -Have You Seen My TAMA?

The characters are Tama, Momo, Wocket, Tiggle, Rockney, Pimmy, Bupkus, Bengpu, and Chopin. There is no consistent plot. Tama and his friends just have little, family friendly, adventures every episode. The only consistency is when a new friend is made one episode and flash backs.



(Source: Anime News Network)
